# Files

The panel's calls for a box's own files. Each one runs as the box user, through the same command path as the terminal. A device box has none.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `files.tree` | The home or a folder and its first level in one command. A name index runs after the tree is drawn. Cached folders reopen before refresh. |
| `files.home` | The box user's home directory, as an absolute path. |
| `files.list` | The names in one directory, in one command. At most 5,000. A name with a newline is left out. |
| `files.read` | A file and its SHA-256. Text up to 4 MB, an image up to 2 MB. Past that, the size and the hash, and no bytes. |
| `files.readRange` | A slice of a file, at most 256 KB, with the whole file's size and SHA-256. |
| `files.write` | Replaces a file. With expectedSha256, writes only when the file still has that hash. Without it, overwrites. |
| `files.create` | Creates a file or a directory. Refuses when the name is taken. |
| `files.rename` | Renames a file or a directory. Refuses when the new name is taken. |
| `files.delete` | Deletes a file or a directory. Refuses the root of the filesystem and the box user's home. |
| `files.search` | Finds lines under a directory. ripgrep when the box has it, otherwise grep. At most 2,000 hits or 500 files. |
| `files.names` | File paths under a directory, for go to file. Skips .git, node_modules and vendor. At most 20,000. |
